Microsoft Telecom News

Powering telecom with intelligence and trust

NOVEMBER 2026 EDITION

This month, Microsoft Ignite made one thing clear: AI is moving out of pilots and into the core of the telecom business. As our Frontier Telco & Media guide to Ignite highlights, the differentiator is no longer the model but the foundation beneath it: trusted data, shared context, and the right guardrails. It was a privilege to share the stage with AT&T in my session on reimagining telecom with agentic AI, and to celebrate Tech Mahindra, our 2026 Telecommunications & Media Partner of the Year, for helping operators build AI-first, autonomous operations on the Microsoft Cloud.

Scaling agents also takes industry alignment, and our collaboration with TM Forum continues: Vodafone and Microsoft are calling for a standard way for AI agents to access skills, so operators don’t have to reinvent the wheel. I’m also proud of Microsoft Research’s contribution to Chronos, a cloud-based RAN emulation system developed with the University of Edinburgh, which shows how AI-driven radio networks can be tested affordably before deployment, at about 100 times the scale of existing solutions.

Our customers show what this looks like in practice. KT paired its expert “Meisters” with Microsoft engineers to build AI agents that diagnose critical network issues in about five minutes, before customers feel them. PLDT is improving its service experience with Amdocs, Dynamics 365, and Azure, cutting average resolution times for complex enterprise services by more than 13 hours, while Telefónica Deutschland secured customer data for about 13,000 partner-shop users with Windows 365 Cloud Apps and cut operating costs by more than 90%. And AT&T Business now offers fiber and Microsoft 365 Business Premium with Copilot in one place, simplifying safe, secure AI adoption for U.S. small and medium businesses.

If you missed Ignite, I encourage you to catch up on the sessions on demand. Thank you, as always, for your partnership this year; I look forward to building on this momentum together.
